initialExam.title: RRB ASM 2026 (Assistant Station Master)
initialExam.description: RRB Assistant Station Master recruitment for managing railway station operations including train movements, signaling, passenger services, and safety protocols.
initialExam.syllabus: CBT-1: General Awareness, Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning. CBT-2: General Awareness, Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning (Advanced).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT-1: 100 questions, 100 marks, 60 min. CBT-2: 120 questions, 120 marks, 90 min. CBAT (Aptitude Test).
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT-1 → CBT-2 → CBAT (Computer Based Aptitude Test) → Document Verification → Medical
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant Station Master managing railway station operations and train safety
initialExam.careerGrowth: ASM → Station Master → Station Superintendent → Deputy Station Superintendent → Senior Station Superintendent.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rrbcdg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Free Railway Pass, Quarters, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
